sentences.text: Klimate is a portfolio company whose country is recorded as DK, and the sources we read hold no register entry for it.
Three funding rounds are on record: EUR 730 000 dated 2021-09-08, EUR 3 500 000 dated 2023-10-17, and another for 2023 with the year only.
A first customer or pilot record is dated 2025-04-22.
Every readiness level is unknown on the radar's rules because the funding is not from a source those rules read.
For the fund the company stays on the watchlist, and the rounds should be checked at their sources.
